schema_note: v1.8 sequencing and cost-benefit methodology responding to the implementability review gap (score 4/5: sequencing and cost-benefit not verifiable at concept stage). Framework only — no ranking conclusions, cost estimates or benefit figures; every step is trigger-gated. Machine-readable companion of proposal.md section '项目排序与成本效益方法论'.

steps.input_state: existing buildings, ownership, utility capacity, measured flows and statutory controls all unknown
steps.method_zh: 依 A-BOUNDARY-002 复算全部指标 + 主管部门数据对接
steps.method_en: Recompute all metrics per A-BOUNDARY-002 + authority data hookup
steps.trigger_zh: 官方几何与控规图则发布
steps.trigger_en: Official geometry and statutory plan released

steps.input_state: 8 renewal projects defined in implementation cards
steps.method_zh: 公共利益 / 可逆性 / 资金路径成熟度 / 文保约束四维加权，权重待协商
steps.method_en: Weighted scoring across public benefit, reversibility, funding-path maturity, heritage constraint; weights negotiable

steps.method_zh: 土地整理 / 建安 / 市政 / 运营四科目分列
steps.method_en: Land, construction, utilities, operations listed separately

steps.method_zh: 公共效益（无障碍/等价路径/投诉响应）与经济代理指标分列
steps.method_en: Public benefit (accessibility, equivalent paths, complaints) separated from economic proxies
steps.trigger_zh: 试点基线测量完成（见 baseline-protocols.json）

steps.input_state: boundary / FAR / flow parameters as perturbation inputs
steps.method_zh: 单参数扰动下的排序稳定性检验，输出稳健区间而非单点结论
steps.method_en: Single-parameter perturbation of ranking stability; robust intervals, not point conclusions

discipline.no_numeric_commitments: no ranking, cost or benefit figures are produced before all triggers are satisfied
discipline.publication_path: conclusions jointly reviewed by district authority and named operator, rolled forward with the 90-day public review
discipline.data_gap_disclosure: organizer data gaps (official geometry, statutory plan, field baselines) remain disclosed; they do not block content scoring

boundary_zh: 概念方法论；不含任何数值结论，全部以触发条件与正式决策为准。
boundary_en: Conceptual methodology; no numeric conclusions; everything pending triggers and formal decisions.
